scope: zero-optimizer-step, non-causal screening audit; fixed-smearing E50 seeds 0+1 fit the utility probe and seed 2 is a held discovery trajectory. Because multiple descriptor families are compared on it, seed 2 is not a final external/blind validation. The conservative autograd energy-gate test is intentionally deferred to R2L

residual_conventions.delta_target_y: REF_forces, the correction missing from foundation base plus q6
residual_conventions.router_atom_utility: non-causal screening proxy ||y||^2 - ||y-p||^2 in (meV/A)^2; it uses the reference target and cannot itself be a deployed input

fixed_E50_vs_historical_R2C_geometry_ove.interpretation: the fixed-smearing labels are exact E50 targets, but all geometries and nearby historical targets were already exposed during depth3/descriptor development; seed2 is only held out from the present linear-probe fit

same_local_perturbation_supercell_invari.construction: same central atom and three-neighbour perturbation in ideal 6x6/8x8 graphene; compare the central invariant and fitted screening score

leakage_control.warning: the depth-3 5 A descriptor can span about 15 A and may sense periodic wrap in the 6x6 support cell; short-cutoff descriptors must be audited in parallel

feature_definitions.screening_router_probe: per-atom signed l=0 scalar channels from frozen descriptor-model node_feats; diagnostic coefficients are not a deployable conservative router
feature_definitions.repair_bond_features: endpoint mean and squared difference of invariant features plus r and r^2

controls.geometry: six sorted neighbour distances and three first-shell angle cosines
controls.bond_length: three first-neighbour distances, squares, mean, min, and max

full_fit_router.threshold_calibration: score > empirical harmonic-calibration 95th percentile (higher method); the disjoint harmonic-external half is used for screening
